info.title: ghpkg
info.description: Interactive CLI tool to browse and delete GitHub package versions (NuGet and npm).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Interactively browse and delete GitHub package versions (NuGet and npm).

options.name: --owner
options.description: Owner of the packages: an organization name, or 'user' for your personal account. Prompted if omitted.

options.name: --type
options.description: Package type: nuget or npm. Prompted if omitted.

options.name: --package
options.description: Package name to manage. Prompted if omitted.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview which versions would be deleted without deleting anything. [default: False]
